decision: Fresh upload is permitted for a single known rate-limit recovery if the earlier transient uploadRef is unavailable, not only expired. No need to wait for expiry.
reason: Signed upload references were intentionally kept transient. No final parse was accepted in explicitly rate-rejected attempts; re-uploading identical frozen bytes cannot duplicate an unknown submitted parse.
constraints: Same frozen bytes/settings and one recovery per rejected input.
Retain both upload records and original rejection.
